rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something in a way that is not normal.

example.english: I got up abnormally early today.
example.traditional: 我今日唔正常咁早起身。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 zing3 soeng4 gam2 zou2 hei2 san1

rows.note: Use this when a behavior or event goes against its usual pattern, rather than merely seeming unusual.

example.english: The market has been rising abnormally for several days.
example.jyutping: go3 si5 faan2 soeng4 gam2 sing1 zo2 gei2 jat6

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written descriptions, especially for an unusually high or low degree.

example.english: Temperatures this month are abnormally low.
example.jyutping: bun2 jyut6 hei3 wan1 ji6 soeng4 dei6 dai1
